summary: Testing of CareLink new features - 14/14 backend tests passed. All static pages (About, Privacy, Terms, Contact) working correctly. Cookie consent banner functional. Footer regions column visible. Admin provider edit page accessible and fully functional with form fields and action buttons.

issues: Playwright tests show redirect to /login when accessing root URL '/' directly in fresh browser context - may be a session initialization timing issue. The page serves correctly (HTTP 200) via curl.

action_items: Verify Landing page loads correctly for first-time visitors in production (potential client-side redirect issue in some contexts)

Static pages (About, Privacy, Terms, Contact) all render correctly with proper Hebrew RTL layout - WORKING
Contact form POST /api/contact endpoint validates required fields and saves to database - WORKING
Cookie consent banner (CookieConsent.js) uses localStorage to persist consent with 3 buttons (Accept All, Customize, Reject) - WORKING
Footer regions column fetches from /api/regions and displays city links - WORKING
Admin provider edit page (AdminProviderEdit.js) loads provider data and allows updates via PUT /api/admin/providers/:providerId - WORKING
